name: ease
purpose: A number moved from 0 to 1 along a curve: linear, in (slow start), out (slow end), inout, or step (0 until the end of the range).

in.doc: the input: a number, or the key of a number

over.doc: [from, to]: the input range that maps to 0 and 1; outside it the output stays at 0 or 1
